items.title: Build a serverless recipe-sharing API with Go and Amazon Aurora DSQL
items.summary: Build a fully serverless recipe-sharing REST API in Go on Amazon Aurora DSQL, AWS Lambda, and Amazon API Gateway. Learn UUID primary keys for even write distribution, short-lived IAM token authentication, application-layer referential integrity, and automatic optimistic-concurrency retries, with a one-command CloudFormation deployment.
items.creator: Steve Brown
